Name: Prevent Energy Loss
Author: Freaksaus
Description:
A mod to stop you from losing energy when you accidentally used the wrong tool. Currently supports the Axe, Pickaxe, Hoe and Watering Can. A few examples where this mod will stop you from wasting your energy:

[list]
[*]Watering an already watered crop[/*]
[*]Using your axe on a stone[/*]
[*]Using your pickaxe on grass[/*]
[*]Using your hoe on an already tilled piece of soil[/*]
[*]etc[/*]
[/list]
To accomplish this, the mod tries to look for valid/intended actions and then makes any other actions free from stamina use.Here is a list of actions that will still cost energy:
[b]Axe[/b]
[list]
[*]Chopping down trees[/*]
[*]Removing crafted items[/*]
[*]Removing crops[/*]
[*]Removing flooring[/*]
[*]Removing logs[/*]
[*]Removing twigs[/*]
[*]Removing stumps[/*]
[*]Removing weeds[/*]
[*]Destroying breakable item[/*]
[/list][b]Pickaxe[/b]
[list]
[*]Mining ore[/*]
[*]Mining stone[/*]
[*]Removing boulders[/*]
[*]Removing crafted items[/*]
[*]Removing first stage trees[/*]
[*]Removing crops[/*]
[*]Removing flooring[/*]
[*]Removing hoed dirt[/*]
[*]Removing meteorites[/*]
[*]Removing weeds[/*]
[*]Destroying breakable items[/*]
[/list][b]Hoe[/b]
[list]
[*]Till artifact spots[/*]
[*]Till dirt[/*]
[*]Removing crafted items[/*]
[*]Removing first stage trees[/*]
[*]Removing weeds[/*]
[*]Destroying breakable items[/*]
[/list][b]Watering Can[/b]
[list]
[*]Water tilled soil that isn't already watered[/*]
[*]Water pet bowl[/*]
[*]Water slime hutch water spots[/*]
[*]Cool down lava in Vulcano Dungeon[/*]
[/list]
If there are any actions I've missed or if the mod stops energy being spent incorrectly please let me know and I'll try to fix it as soon as possible.

Source code can be found on [url=https://github.com/Freaksaus/PreventEnergyLoss]GitHub[/url]
